_readme: Hand-maintained fixes for city markers. 'add' lists Wikidata item ids for cities the automatic queries miss (their name, location and population are still fetched from Wikidata by scripts/importers/wikidata-city-additions.mjs). 'exclude' lists names to drop (metro areas etc. that slip through the filters).

usStatesExclude._note: Names to drop from US state city lists, keyed by state FIPS code.
